title: Estimating Cure Models in High Dimensions: A Guide with hdcuremodels
text: workflow fitting mixture cure model include assessment two assumptions: first, non-zero cure fraction present; second, sufficient follow-(Maller Zhou, 1996). Inferential tests assessing two assumptions included hdcuremodels package. functions nonzerocure_test sufficient_fu_test take survfit object argument.  can seen Kaplan-Meier plot, long-plateau drop zero. may indicate presence cured fraction. can test null hypothesis cured fraction zero alternative hypothesis cured fraction zero using nonzerocure_test (Maller Zhou, 1996). Given small p-value reject null hypothesis conclude non-zero cure fraction present. can also extract cured fraction Kaplan-Meier estimate beyond last observed event (Goldman, 1991) using cure_estimate function. estimate requires sufficiently long follow-can tested using sufficient_fu_test function (Maller Zhou, 1996). function tests null hypothesis insufficient follow-alternative sufficient follow-. Based results, reject null hypothesis conclude sufficient follow-. verified two assumptions, can now fit mixture cure model.
